source.implements: what Remove and Update take off the phone for one kept list: the kept export, the list, its out-of-date row, its per-battle ticks (wh-used-<id>), its Phase checklist boxes (wh-check-<id>), its Strategic reserves boxes (wh-res-<id>) and its star

20.01 Placing Units in Strategic Reserves, read from data.js RULES: the step ("Before the battle, in the Declare Battle Formations step"), the units excluded ("(excluding **FORTIFICATIONS**)": the keyword, singular), the limit sentence and its percentage ("cannot exceed 50% of your points limit for your battle size"); none of them typed by hand, null where the words say none

note: Unchanged (ok in result-reserves.json). The limit is GW Core Rules 20.01 (PDF p68, verify/texts.js) as data.js RULES has it: 50% of the points limit, 1000 pts at Strike Force; no unit-count limit in GW's text.

source.implements: GRANTS rows that give a unit of the list a rule (Deep Strike) when units are placed in strategic reserves: an army rule of its faction or a detachment rule of the list (the row's rule name) to units whose keywords its to names (unit); the unit's own usable ability (an enhancement too) whose words contain the row's text, to "this unit" (unit) or "this model" / "the bearer" (model, with its who); a pick 'one' row (a selection, "select one friendly <KW> unit. That unit has …"): the ability on any unit of the list, to every unit its to allows, the giver's own too (may); none whose ability's CHECKLIST entry has a trigger (t or at): given in the battle (20.02 repositioning). By words, not list id, so an imported list finds them

note: Fix of result-reserves.json: a selection (GRANTS pick one, verify/derive.js grantRows) shows on every unit its keywords allow, the giver's own too (nerf-when: Calgar + Bladeguard, Librarian in Phobos Armour, Heavy Intercessors, Eradicators, Reivers); grants given in the battle (CHECKLIST t or at: Umbralefic Crystal, Mysterious Guardian) are dropped; a grant to this model / the bearer is a model grant.

judgement.code: const resInBattle = ab => { const e = (D.checklist || {})['a|' + ckHash(ab.name + '\n' + ab.text)] || {}; return !!(e.t || e.at); };

source.implements: a grant given in the battle, not when units are placed in strategic reserves: its ability's CHECKLIST entry (verify/derive.js) has a trigger, t (a phase: Umbralefic Crystal, In your Command phase) or at (a moment: Mysterious Guardian, At the end of your opponent's turn)

note: New: in-battle grants by the ability's CHECKLIST trigger (t: Umbralefic Crystal command:your; at: Mysterious Guardian End of your opponent's turn). Thunderhawk Insertion, Lord of the Eightbound, Disciple of Khorne, Nazdreg's Know-wotz have none (u only).

source.implements: a grant's condition against the list: none, or only the selection's moment (In the Declare Battle Formations step): true; "If this model is attached to a <KW> unit during the Declare Battle Formations step": true when the unit is attached (leads) and its keywords make up <KW>, else false; any other condition: null (shown as conditional, with GW's words)

note: New: Lord of the Eightbound on the unattached Slaughterbound (standard) is false, so no mark; attached units (princes, standard) already have Deep Strike on their Rules line.

source.implements: 24.09 Deep Strike ("if every model in this unit has this ability"): own when the Rules line (unitRules) has it and no model alone has it (partialRules); part: that model, and a model grant (resGrants model) on a unit of more than one model, its model once (none when own); grants: whole-unit grants whose condition holds (resWhile true); may: selection grants; cond: grants whose condition the list does not settle; none for a condition the list shows false

note: Fix: Disciple of Khorne is now only "Deep Strike: Lord on Juggernaut only" (the model grant merges into part); conditional grants show as "Deep Strike if:"; none in the lists today.

judgement.code: const resBoxes = u => Array.from({ length:u.copies || 1 }, (_, i) => u.id + ((u.copies || 1) > 1 ? '#' + i : ''));

source.implements: one reserves box per unit, one per copy of a ×N unit (u.id, u.id#i)

the running total: each ticked box counts its unit's points (u.pts, as the list prints them; an attached unit's whole), excluded units (resRule excl) never; the limit is floor(the list's points limit × GW's percentage / 100): 1000 pts at Strike Force 2000
the total pinned under the top bar: points in reserves / the limit, the units ticked, and the points left or, over the limit, how far over (in the bad-news colour)

Strategic reserves: the pinned total (resBar), the step and GW's limit sentence quoted with a link to the rule, every unit of the list in list order with a box per copy (a 44px tap area; excluded units: box disabled, marked "<KEYWORD>: excluded" linking the rule), its points, and its Deep Strike marks (resDeepStrike): "Deep Strike" (own), "Deep Strike: <model> only" (part), "Deep Strike · <rule or ability>" (a whole-unit grant), "can be given Deep Strike · <ability> (<giver>)" (may), "Deep Strike if: <rule or ability>" (cond), each grant with the row's words quoted (both sentences of a selection); boxes kept per list (wh-res-<id>), Reset (44px) clears them (with Undo)

note: Fix: tap areas 44px (::after inset -7px on the 30px box; Reset min 44px); the mark kinds; the selection quoted with both sentences.

source.implements: Remove: the list leaves the phone (the kept export, the list, its per-battle ticks, its Phase checklist boxes and its Strategic reserves boxes), the app goes to the home screen

note: Nit: its description now names the Strategic reserves boxes (code unchanged).
